record.question: A Patient Information Leaflet (PIL) in pharmaceutical practice, is defined as:
options: A technical document for pharmacists detailing drug stability testing and information on drug formulations.
A legal contract between the prescriber and patient outlining liability for side effects that can occur
A promotional brochure prepared by pharmaceutical companies to market newly launched drugs.
A simplified written document that provides essential medicine-related information for patients in an easy-to-understand format
record.explanation: Answer D: A simplified written document that provides essential medicine-related information for patients in an easy-to-understand format. A patient information leaflet is a simplified written document that communicates essential medicine information to patients in understandable language. Reference: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/human-regulatory-overview/marketing-authorisation/product-information-requirements/patient-information-leaflets. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
